# IntensityChart

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Scrolling 2-D color map: spectrogram or waterfall (CHART-101).

![IntensityChart, light theme](../img/widgets/intensity-chart-light.png#only-light){ width="428" }
![IntensityChart, dark theme](../img/widgets/intensity-chart-dark.png#only-dark){ width="428" }

**Graphs, time** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.IntensityChart) ·
schema [`intensitychart.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.IntensityChart(
    label="IntensityChart",
    history=120,
    n_bins=48,
    dt=0.05,
    y_max=2400,
    x_unit="s",
    unit="dB",
    size=(420, 200),
)
```

The data of the picture (samples, history or drawing) is sent with the widget's methods,
not as traits: see the [widget catalog](../widgets.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | object | `{}` | host | Summary of the latest row {rows, min, max, argmax}, written by the host with each append. |
| `history` | integer | `200` | host | Rows kept and shown. |
| `n_bins` | integer | `64` | host | Values per row. |
| `dt` | number | `1` | host | Time step between rows in x-axis units; 0 is shown as 1. |
| `y_min` | number | `0` | host | Value of the lower edge of the first bin. |
| `y_max` | number or null | `null` | host | Value of the upper edge of the last bin; null: y_min + n_bins. |
| `z_min` | number | `0` | host | Color range when autoscale_z is off. |
| `z_max` | number | `1` | host |  |
| `autoscale_z` | boolean | `true` | host |  |
| `colormap` | `"viridis"`, `"inferno"`, `"magma"`, `"plasma"`, `"gray"`, `"jet"` | `"viridis"` | host |  |
| `show_colorbar` | boolean | `true` | host |  |
